description: Preparation path for the SAT Math section (digital SAT): 44 questions across 2 modules of 35 minutes each; ~75% four-option multiple-choice, ~25% student-produced response; calculator permitted throughout; no penalty for wrong answers. This unit covers the Algebra domain (~35% of Math): linear equations, functions, systems, and inequalities — sourced from College Board's published content domains.
title: SAT — Math: Algebra
